en.home.001: ORVA Protocol connects real natural gas production, transmission, storage and trading with verifiable on-chain rights. Explore its RWA mapping, architecture, token mechanisms and governance plans.
en.home.002: ORVA Protocol — Real Energy, Verifiable Rights
en.home.004: ORVA Protocol — Real Energy, Verifiable Rights
en.home.003: An RWA-DeFi protocol plan grounded in real energy operating cash flow.
en.home.019: Built on natural gas production, transmission, storage and trading, ORVA Protocol maps verified operating data and contractual cash flow to standardized RWA rights. ORVA connects staking incentives with protocol governance.
en.home.040: The whitepaper proposes the integrated natural gas project in Kaijiang County, Sichuan as its industrial foundation, covering gas supply, gathering and transmission, seasonal storage and trade settlement. Off-chain operations produce contracts, metering and payment records; the protocol registers rights and coordinates rules on-chain.
en.home.054: These are planned parameters stated in the whitepaper. They do not indicate completed construction, commissioned facilities or achieved operating results.
en.home.056: One energy value chain. Four operating stages.
en.home.057: A recordable, verifiable business chain from dispersed gas sources to industrial users.
en.home.061: Integrate nearby gas sources and record production and custody-transfer measurements.
en.home.064: Purify and compress gas, then transport it through the pipeline network.
en.home.067: Schedule injection, withdrawal and storage capacity use around seasonal demand.
en.home.070: Verify operations against contracts, metering reports and payment records.
en.home.082: Every RWA issuance requires an off-chain commercial contract, oracle-verified metering data and confirmation by the Industry Committee.
en.home.087: Represent a share of net revenue from nearby wells’ gas sales, recorded for the corresponding revenue period.
en.home.093: Represent settlement income from gas gathering, processing and transmission services.
en.home.099: Represent capacity usage for summer injection and winter withdrawal, without conveying ownership of physical natural gas.
en.home.105: Represent a share of net trading income supported by purchase and sales contracts and settlement records.
en.home.108: RWA certificates represent economic rights defined by the protocol, not ownership of physical natural gas. Minting, transfer and burning require the verification and approval conditions set out in the whitepaper.
en.home.113: ORVA is the protocol’s native staking, reward and governance token. The whitepaper specifies a fixed supply with no further minting. Reward and voting weights depend on the locked amount, lock term and actual participation time.
en.home.130: Allocation, use and vesting schedules reflect whitepaper plans and remain subject to formal contracts and announcements.
en.home.133: Users choose a lock term. Longer commitments and actual participation increase reward and governance weights. The whitepaper illustrates 3, 6 and 12-month options.
en.home.139: Recover staked ORVA under the rules, with no penalty at maturity.
en.home.141: A specified proportion is deducted and transferred to the protocol treasury.
en.home.147: Distribution depends on eligible protocol income actually received by the treasury. It is not a promise of fixed income or returns.
en.home.164: Record rights certificates and key metrics on-chain; cross-chain mapping requires compliance review.
en.home.179: Rights registration · Weight calculation · Governance records · Audit hashes
en.home.185: Governance applies to protocol and ecosystem rules. Physical construction, operational safety and natural gas operations remain the legal responsibility of off-chain businesses.
en.home.188: Verify asset authenticity and compliance before participation.
en.home.202: The DAO does not control off-chain production equipment, gas storage operations, gas pricing or commercial contracts. Opinions on off-chain operations are advisory and do not bind the operating businesses.
en.home.227: ORVA PROTOCOL / REAL ENERGY, VERIFIABLE RIGHTS
en.paper.155: Real-world operations (using the estimates in the appendix): the gas gathering station charges CNY 0.1 per cubic meter for gathering and transmission, generating annual service-fee income of CNY 30 million. Gas trading profit is estimated at CNY 0.5 per cubic meter, or approximately CNY 150 million annually. Gas storage operating profit is estimated at CNY 1 per cubic meter, or approximately CNY 300 million annually. Annual processing, trading and storage throughput is 300 million cubic meters.
